6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: The next speaker was announced: Chancellor Emmerich Hegel of the Democratic Republic of Valgsland.

37.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

39.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Neutral"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement_Rusty"] == false)  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Friendly"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Bad"] == true)  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Unfriendly"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement_Rusty"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Lespia_GlobalImage"] == true)

40.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
40.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Neutral"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement_Rusty"] == false)  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Friendly"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Bad"] == true)  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Unfriendly"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement_Rusty"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Lespia_GlobalImage"] == true)) == false

43.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
43.text: "Ladies and gentlemen. Leaders of the world."

44.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
44.text: "I stand here to hold the Kingdom of Rizia accountable for the crimes they have committed in Southern Merkopa!"

45.speaker: Narrator
45.text: Laurento and I looked at each other.

46.speaker: Narrator
46.text: A roar of outrage and confusion rose in the chamber.

56.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
56.text: "Guilty of waging a destructive war marked by military failure."

60.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
60.text: "Guilty of using deadly experimental weapons on the citizens of another country."

61.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
61.text: "Guilty of repeatedly using deadly experimental weapons on the citizens of another country."

65.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
65.text: "Guilty of displacing massive numbers of people, causing refugee waves across the continent."

69.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
69.text: "Guilty of displacing enough people to cause refugee waves across the continent."

73.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
73.text: "And even guilty of transporting those refugees to Morella! A country that has nothing to do with Rizia's war."

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "Rizia has a right to defend itself!"

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "Our war in Pales is completely justified. You are saying this only because of your interests."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "You are conveniently forgetting your own guilt, Alvarez!"

83.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
83.text: "I demand the continuation of my speech!"

84.speaker: Narrator
84.text: The crowd in the chamber roared louder. I heard some voices telling me to sit down and others telling me to go on.

85.speaker: Narrator
85.text: President Nines hit the gavel many times until there was silence.

86.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
86.text: "Thank you. Now, where did I leave off?"

87.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
87.text: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Alliance of Nations, we do not want war in Merkopa. We want peace."

88.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
88.text: "But that peace has been sabotaged by the archaic methods of this 'Kingdom'."

89.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
89.text: "They blocked independent journalists from entering their war zone so they could hide the truth. Pales is being destroyed before our eyes."

90.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
90.text: "We have all read the headlines and watched the television broadcasts. We have seen the horrific images."

91.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
91.text: "Are we expected to stand back and watch this humanitarian crisis unfold right before our eyes?"

92.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
92.text: "They have murdered women and children alike. They've burned villages, schools... Hospitals, for God's sake!"

93.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
93.text: "What they are doing should be completely obvious! This is a scorched earth policy."

97.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
97.text: "Are we expected to be complicit in these crimes against humanity?"

99.speaker: Narrator
99.text: He hit the podium with a stack of papers.

100.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
100.text: "Ladies and gentlemen. Leaders of the world!"

101.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
101.text: "Lespia is hereby officially calling for heavy sanctions on this war-mongering nation. We ask anyone with a conscience to vote in favor of them."

103.speaker: Narrator
103.text: The commotion in the hall grew even louder as Alvarez left the stage.

104.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
104.text: "This does not look good, Your Majesty."

105.speaker: Player_Romus
105.text: "Even if we get sanctioned, we will adapt and survive."

110.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
110.text: "All who are in favor of sanctions on the Kingdom of Rizia, say 'Aye'. All opposed, say 'Nay'."

113.speaker: Narrator
113.text: He looked at where Leon Malenyev was sitting.

115.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
115.text: "It has been brought to my attention that a certain country in Southern Merkopa is engaging in malicious actions with the intent of heavily destabilizing the region."

116.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
116.text: "My duty to the people of Valgsland prevents me from being quiet against this injustice."

117.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
117.text: "Against the tyranny of a so-called 'Kingdom'. A remnant of the ugly past."

119.speaker: Narrator
119.text: Laurento and I looked at each other.

120.speaker: Narrator
120.text: A roar of outrage and confusion rose in the chamber.

127.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
127.text: "I cannot describe to you how disappointed I am that in this day and age, millions of people in Merkopa are still afflicted by the poison that is monarchy."

128.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
128.text: "The Rizians suffer under the iron fist of a King. A man elected by no one, beholden to no one."

129.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
129.text: "He sits on his throne, reaping the fruits of his citizen's labors."

130.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
130.text: "Crushing them under the weight of his menace. Not because he earned it. Because he was born to it."

131.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
131.text: "My ideological opposition to Mr. Toras' government is well known to all of you. But that is not what I am here to talk about today."

132.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
132.text: "Rizia has been supporting a far-right nationalist organization, Su Omina, in its attempts to violently and underhandedly take over Zille."

133.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
133.text: "I am here to talk about what they are doing to justify their vile existence."

134.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
134.text: "Rizian troops have been brutally crushing a democratic uprising in the Confederacy of Vendonesam."

135.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
135.text: "Rizia has been using excessive force to quell the peaceful protests of its own citizens."
135.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_QuelledProtests"] > 5) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn05_ZilleResistanceFunding_BeginSOFund"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_ViolentResistancePower"] > 2) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vendonesam_SupportLevel"] > 2) == false)

137.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
137.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_QuelledProtests"] > 5) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn05_ZilleResistanceFunding_BeginSOFund"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_ViolentResistancePower"] > 2) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vendonesam_SupportLevel"] > 2) == false)

138.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
138.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_QuelledProtests"] > 5) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn05_ZilleResistanceFunding_BeginSOFund"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_ViolentResistancePower"] > 2) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vendonesam_SupportLevel"] > 2) == false)

141.speaker: Player_Romus
141.text: "Now I'm a tyrant? You were all too happy to cooperate with me when it meant screwing over Lespia, *comrade*."

142.speaker: Player_Romus
142.text: "Rizia does not have to justify its actions!"

145.speaker: Narrator
145.text: The crowd in the chamber roared louder. I heard some voices telling me to sit down and others telling me to go on.

146.speaker: Narrator
146.text: President Nines hit the gavel many times until there was silence.

148.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
148.text: "The unfortunate plight of the Bludish people is known to us. But banning them from the border? That is inhumane at best."

149.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
149.text: "Rizia has been helping to persecute Wehlen's Bludish minority under the guise of an attack against the BFF."
149.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true)

150.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
150.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true) == false)

151.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
151.text: "Many of you in this room may be unaware of Rizia's actions, thanks to the monarchy's merciless censorship of the media."

152.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
152.text: "I know that some of you have even been bribed into participating in Rizian media campaigns."

154.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
154.text: "But what I have just mentioned should be enough to incriminate the Kingdom of Rizia."

155.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
155.text: "And I call upon my fellow world leaders to pass official sanctions on Rizia. Heavy ones."

156.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
156.text: "Our motto has not changed. 'Through broken shackles'. So I call upon you all."

158.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
158.text: "I call upon the people of Rizia to free themselves from their oppressors and break their shackles."

159.speaker: Narrator
159.text: The commotion grew louder than ever as Hegel left the stage.

160.speaker: Narrator
160.text: Ayes and Nays followed from different directions. With every Aye, I winced.
